# API Keys, FRED API Version 1

* * *

* * *

[Request or view your API keys](https://fredaccount.stlouisfed.org/apikeys)

Note that you cannot [request or view your API keys](https://fredaccount.stlouisfed.org/apikeys) without first logging into
your [fredaccount.stlouisfed.org](https://fredaccount.stlouisfed.org/) user account.

- All web service requests require an API key to identify requests.
- Developers should request a distinct API key for each application they build.
- All users of an application shall use their own API key.

The API key is set using the api\_key variable, a 32 character lower-cased alpha-numeric string.

Below is an example HTTP GET request:

```
https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/search?api_key=abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456&search_text=canada
```

Note that API key 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456' is for demonstration purposes only. Use one of your [registered API keys](https://fredaccount.stlouisfed.org/apikeys) instead.
